definitions.name: O3D.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'BS' BIND 1 8 RANGE BS [ 'IG' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String with adjacent matched pairs () and [] deleted repeatedly (8 passes, enough for 16 chars); '' when balanced

definitions.name: O3D.SIGNS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BC' BIND -1 1 '([' BC SEARCH NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to a Vector of +1 per opener ( [ and -1 per closer ) ]

definitions.name: O3D.DEPTH
definitions.body: O3D.SIGNS 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: greatest nesting depth of a bracket String: max of the running open count and 0

definitions.name: O3D.BALPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS '' [ 2 COLLECT JOIN ] SCAN [ O3D.REDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: O3D.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND 1 1 COLLECT RV 1 DROP RV -1 DROP SUB [ 'RD' BIND 0 1 RD 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP CONCAT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector of numbers to a same-length Vector numbering its runs of equal adjacent values 1 2 3 ...

definitions.name: O3D.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV O3D.RUNIDS RV GROUP VALUES [ 'RG' BIND RG 0 GET RG LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: run-length encoding of a Vector of numbers: [ value count ] per maximal run of equal adjacent values, in order

definitions.name: O3D.DEDUPE
definitions.body: O3D.RLE [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of numbers with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one value

definitions.name: O3D.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP RV -1 DROP GT 0 [ 'RU' BIND 1 ADD 0 RU SELECT ] SCAN 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV 1 ADD
definitions.note: length of the longest strictly increasing stretch of adjacent values in a non-empty Vector of numbers (1 for a single value)

definitions.name: O3D.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'JV' BIND JV TALLY 'JT' BIND JT G0A.TOPKEY 'JK' BIND JK NIL JT JK GET 2 MUL JV LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: the value occurring in more than half the positions of a Vector, or NIL when none does

definitions.name: O3D.MISS
definitions.body: [ 'ME' BIND 1 0 ME NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector to a same-length Vector of 1 per NIL element and 0 per present element

definitions.name: O3D.GAPS
definitions.body: O3D.MISS 'MM' BIND MM 0 1 COLLECT MM -1 DROP CONCAT SUB [ 1 EQ ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: number of runs of consecutive NIL elements in a Vector

definitions.name: O3D.LONGESTGAP
definitions.body: O3D.MISS 0 [ 'MF' BIND 1 ADD MF MUL ] SCAN G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NIL elements in a non-empty Vector (0 when none is NIL)

definitions.name: O3D.FILL
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV SV O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'SE' BIND 'SA' BIND SA SE SE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: forward fill: each NIL replaced by the nearest present element before it, leading NILs by the first present element

definitions.name: O3D.OR1
definitions.body: 'OV' BIND 1 OV OV NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: the value itself, or 1 when it is NIL

definitions.name: O3D.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV 1 DROP SV -1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ [ 'RA' 'RB' ] BIND RA O3D.OR1 RB O3D.OR1 DIV NIL RA NIL? NOT RB NIL? NOT AND SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: each element divided by the one before it (one shorter than the input); NIL where either is NIL

definitions.name: O3D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV O1D.PRESENT G0D.MAXV 'SM' BIND SV [ 'SE' BIND NIL SE O3D.OR1 SM DIV SE NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: each present element divided by the largest present element; NIL elements stay NIL

definitions.name: O3D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: O3D.ABS
definitions.body: 'AV' BIND AV AV -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value of a number; lifts over a Vector

definitions.name: O3D.MAD
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX MX O3D.MEDIAN SUB O3D.ABS O3D.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: O3D.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX -2 DROP MX 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MX 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers of a Vector of at least three (two fewer elements)

definitions.name: O3D.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX MX 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty Vector of numbers, same length

definitions.name: O3D.TRIMMED
definitions.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: mean of a Vector of at least three numbers after removing one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: O3D.DEBTORS
definitions.body: O2D.BYKEY 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs to the names whose amounts sum below zero, in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O3D.LONGEST
definitions.body: 'LW' BIND LW LW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: longest String in a non-empty Vector of Strings, first on ties

definitions.name: O3D.MAXENTRY
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: the [ name amount ] pair with the largest amount in a Vector of pairs, first on ties

definitions.name: O3D.INITIALS
definitions.body: [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: Vector of non-empty Strings to one String of their upper-cased first letters ('' for empty)

solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER O3D.INITIALS
